n: 48 Inch Professional Dual Fuel Liquid Propane Range In Stainless Steel
desc: THOR Kitchen offers the power and performance of a premium professional appliance at a practical price. The THOR Kitchen 48 Inch Dual Fuel Range is a stainless-steel machine that is designed with professional features and functionality.
hl: From a high-powered 18,000 BTU burner to a burner with a steady 650 BTU simmer function, this range gives you the power you need for large family meals and the consistent low heat desired for cooking delicate sauces or melting chocolate
Telescopic racks use ball bearing rack guides for an effortless glide in and out of the oven.
Heating element distributes heat evenly for excellent boiling and baking
